{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Thunder Magnet.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Cima]] |location= Lakeside Stable |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Rubber Helm}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Thunder Magnet||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Thunder Magnet}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Lakeside Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At the [[Lakeside Stable]], [[Link]] can meet [[Cima]], who works at the location. She complains that [[Lightning]] strikes the [[Stable]] so often that she now becomes nervous whenever it starts to [[Rain]].{{Cite|Oh dear, oh dear... {{Color BotW|Red|Lightning}} strike this stable so often, I get nervous whenever it rains even a little.|Cima|BotW}} Since she does not understand why this happens, she asks Link to figure out the source of the issue for her.{{Cite|I just don't understand why it strikes so often... Hey, it's a long shot, but if you have some time, could you find out why?|Cima|BotW}} If Link agrees, Cima will tell him that she is counting on him,{{Cite|You will?! Really? I'm so happy! I'm counting on you.|Cima|BotW}} which begins the [[Side Quest]]. On top of Lakeside Stable, Link will find a [[Woodcutter's Axe]].{{Cite|It turns out the {{Color BotW|Red|lightning}} was drawn to Lakeside Stable because of a metal weapon stuck on top of the building!|Adventure Log|BotW}} As it is made of metal, it attracts Lightning during thunderstorms. After removing the Axe, Link must then inform Cima of his findings.{{Cite|Head back to Cima, and let her know what was going on.|Adventure Log|BotW}} Back on the ground, Cima asks Link if he found out what was attracting Lightning to the Stable.{{Cite|What? You found out what was drawing the {{Color BotW|Red|lightning}} here?|Cima|BotW}} When she hears about the Woodcutter's Axe, she remarks that it makes sense that it would be the cause.{{Cite|[It was a metal axe.] Aha! Yeah, that's as good as a lightning rod, isn't it?|Cima|BotW}} She also wonders if it was put on top of the Stable on purpose.{{Cite|I wonder if someone put it up there on purpose. How strange...|Cima|BotW}} To thank Link, Cima gives him the [[Rubber Helm]].{{Cite|Thanks for looking into it for me! Here's something for your trouble.|Cima|BotW}} Now that Cima can relax,{{Cite|I can finally relax!|Cima|BotW}} the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Cima is feeling really gloomy, likely because of all the {{Color BotW|Red|lightning}}.

Lakeside Stable seems to attract lightning strikes constantly, and Cima has asked you to figure out why. |- | 2 | It turns out the {{Color BotW|Red|lightning}} was drawn to Lakeside Stable because of a metal weapon stuck on top of the building!

Head back to Cima, and let her know what was going on. |- | Complete | Cima seems relieved to hear the news, though it sounds like she still hates all the noise a thunderstorm makes. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Cima * Lakeside Stable * Rubber Helm }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
